newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran, Iraq to swap bodies of soldiers killed in war.
newsitem.headline: Iran, Iraq to swap bodies of soldiers killed in war.

text.p: Iran and Iraq on Sunday exchanged the bodies of 87 soldiers killed during their 1980-88 war, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said.

It quoted Brigadier General Mirfeisal Baqerzadeh, head of Iran's committee for the missing in action, as saying the remains of 20 Iranians were exchanged for those of 67 Iraqi soldiers at the Khosravi border checkpoint in northwestern Iran.

The two sides have previosuly swapped prisoners of war and remains of soldiers. But the missing in action and the POWs are still among the thorniest issues hindering efforts to improve ties between the former foes.
Iran has said 5,000 to 10,000 prisoners are held by Iraq. Baghdad denies holding any Iranians and says more than 20,000 Iraqis are held by Tehran.
